title: Process / Data Analyst
text: Process / Data Analyst at TROOCOO (Brisbane, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Contract/Temp; salary: not stated). Our client has a new opportunity for an experienced Process Analyst to undertake business analysis on a project or key initiative within the Transformation Delivery program, supporting the goals and objectives of the business unit. Role Responsibilites: Build process & data audit templates / checklists Document strawman definitions, principles, customer entity types Identify target state business process changes based on process impacts (from Phase 2 Process Audits) Using facilitation methods, analytical tools and techniques, elicit, assess, and analyse the customer and/or business problem and associated case for change; Participate throughout the delivery lifecycle in an active capacity that is deemed necessary to ensure the proposed change or business improvement is implemented and embedded successfully, the outcome is delivered and accepted by stakeholders, and the targeted benefits are realised Essential Skillset: Highly developed skills in data modelling and process modelling, documenting and communicating process flows in a variety of formats Ability to analyse data and processes, model data, verify and validate data Undertake data and process analysis, interpret and investigate data to provide advice and recommendation to assist in the Customer Master Data Model design Knowledge of data model patterns and reference data and data governance and frameworks experience, Information Architecture and Data Standardisation Demonstrated experience with CRM systems essential If you have the relevant experience and required skill-set please apply today to be considered for this opportunity. Please apply by submitting your application in word format only, or for further information, please email Frances Standen at TROOCOO: frances.standen@troocoo.com
